autarky.description: Share of consumption covered without the grid.

authorization.description: Releasing a charging point for charging, e.g. by RFID or app.

batteryBoost.description: Smart mode setting: charge the vehicle from the home battery down to a limit.

batteryCharge.description: Energy flowing into the home battery.

batteryDischarge.description: Energy flowing out of the home battery.

card.description: A boxed UI panel on a page. Not tile or panel.

charged.description: Energy that went into the vehicle or battery during a session or period.

chargeLevel.description: State of charge of a vehicle or home battery in percent. SoC only in code and data exports, never in UI text.

chargeLevelShort.description: Short form of charge level for labels and table headers.

charger.description: Device level: the wallbox hardware. The charging point is the loadpoint using it.

chargingPlan.description: Target charge level by a point in time. Plural also names the feature and its dialog.

chargingSession.description: One plug-in to unplug cycle, as shown in the sessions log.

chargingSessionShort.description: Short form of charging session for tight spaces such as the tab bar.

cheapEnergy.description: Grid energy below the price limit.

circuit.description: Nestable load management group with a current or power limit that caps everything below it.

circuitRoot.description: Top-level circuit of the nesting, usually the grid connection. All other circuits sit below it.

cleanEnergy.description: Grid energy below the CO₂ limit.

co2.description: Carbon dioxide. Written with the Unicode subscript character ₂ in every language, not CO2.

co2Limit.description: Maximum grid CO₂ intensity at which smart mode charges from the grid.

consumer.description: A metered load that evcc does not control, part of house consumption.

consumption.description: Energy used in the house excluding charging and heating controlled by evcc.

cost.description: Total amount of money for a session or period. Price is per kWh, cost is the sum.

curtailment.description: Limiting PV production, e.g. the 60% or 70% rule.

dialog.description: Overlay opened from a page for settings or confirmations. Called modal only in code.

dynamicTariff.description: Tariff whose prices change over time, e.g. every hour or 15 minutes.

emissions.description: CO₂ caused by charged energy, in kg or g/kWh.

energy.description: Amount over time, in Wh or kWh. Not power.

energyFlow.description: Live diagram of production, grid, battery and consumption.

energyPrice.description: Price per kWh at a point in time.

evcc.description: Product name. Always lowercase in every language, also at sentence start.

externalLimit.description: Limit imposed by the grid operator or an external system. Code says HEMS for historical reasons; never use that acronym for this feature in UI text.

gridExport.description: Energy fed into the grid. Short label export inside a grid card. One term throughout, no synonyms such as feed-in.

gridExportTariff.description: Tariff for energy fed into the grid, i.e. the remuneration. Builds on the grid export term; one word for both is fine if the language has no distinction.

gridImport.description: Energy taken from the grid. Short label import inside a grid card.

gridImportTariff.description: Tariff for energy taken from the grid.

gridMeter.description: Meter at the grid connection point.

guestVehicle.description: Unknown vehicle at a charging point, not configured in evcc.

heatingDevice.description: Device level: heat pump, heating rod etc. The heating counterpart of a charger.

homeBattery.description: Stationary battery in the house, as opposed to the vehicle battery.

loadpoint.description: Developer term for the controllable unit on top of a device, i.e. a charging point or a heater. Never used in UI text.

loadpointCharging.description: Loadpoint built on a charger, controls a vehicle.

loadpointHeating.description: Loadpoint built on a heating device, the heating counterpart of a charging point.

meter.description: Device that reports power and energy at one point of the installation, e.g. grid, solar, battery or consumer. Inverters and batteries act as meters too.

meterReading.description: Cumulative energy counter of a meter in kWh, e.g. at session start and stop.

meterUsage.description: Role of a meter in the installation: grid, solar, battery, charger or consumer.

minimumCharge.description: Desired charge level that should be charged regardless of surplus or price.

modeBoost.description: Label of the Fast mode for continuous heating devices: request more power now. SG Ready mode 3.

modeFast.description: Charge mode: full power now. Labelled Boost for continuous heating devices and On for switchable devices.

modeNormal.description: Label of the Off mode for continuous heating devices, which keep running on their own. SG Ready mode 2.

modeOff.description: Charge mode: no charging. Shown as Normal for continuous heating devices.

modeOn.description: Label of the Fast mode for switchable devices: switch on now.

modeSmart.description: Charge mode: surplus plus cheap or clean grid energy, following plans and limits. Keep the English word in your language. Translate only if the English word would irritate users.

optimizer.description: Battery and charging optimization feature. Keep the English word in your language. Translate only if the English word would irritate users.

page.description: Top-level view reachable from the tab bar or menu.

pageCharge.description: The start page with charging points and energy flow, named after its tab bar label.

power.description: Instantaneous rate, in W or kW. Not energy.

priceLimit.description: Maximum price per kWh at which smart mode charges from the grid.

production.description: Energy generated on site. Usually PV, deliberately open to other sources like wind.

savings.description: Money saved compared to charging everything from the grid at the reference price.

selfConsumption.description: Share of solar production used on site instead of exported.

solar.description: Energy from the PV system. Always solar in English, not PV or photovoltaic.

solarSystem.description: The PV installation as a device.

sponsorToken.description: Token that unlocks sponsor-only features and devices. Two words, lowercase in body text.

summativeEnergyMeasurement.description: Meter nets signed power across phases each instant. Not phase balancing, not net metering.

surplus.description: Production minus house consumption, available for charging or heating.

switchableSocket.description: Socket, plug or relay that is switched on and off, integrated as a charger.

tariff.description: Price structure over time for grid import or grid export, static or dynamic.

tariffSurcharge.description: Fixed amount per kWh added to the energy price, e.g. grid fees or provider margin. Not the charge level.

usage.description: Energy overview view showing where energy went.

valueRange.description: Span between lowest and highest value in a forecast or chart, e.g. price or temperature range.

vehicle.description: An EV known to evcc, with its battery capacity and charge level.

vehicleLimit.description: Charge limit set in the vehicle itself, not in evcc.

vehicleRange.description: Distance a vehicle can drive, in km or mi.

withdrawal.description: Energy taken from a costly source: grid import and battery discharge. Counterpart of production in the energy chart, which groups energy used directly from own sources. Not a financial term.
